source_summary: Vertical ink-and-wash Chinese mountain landscape with towering pale cliffs, layered rock ledges, misty distant ridges, a lakeside village, leafless foreground trees, dark grove accents, and foreground water. Calligraphy and seals occupy the upper sky area and are excluded from motifs.

motifs.name: upper_craggy_summits
motifs.description: Isolate the high central-right mountain crown: stacked horizontal rock shelves, angular crags, pale unpainted summit planes, and jagged ridge contours descending from the upper right.
motifs.role: distant mountain summit and cliff crown
must_preserve: dry horizontal texture strokes across the flat rock shelves
broken ink outlines defining jagged cliff edges
pale reserved-paper summit faces
small dark crevice marks and fractured ledge geometry
soft wash transitions around the rock masses without including calligraphy or seals

motifs.name: left_misty_ridges_lake
motifs.description: Isolate the hazy left-side valley with distant overlapping mountain silhouettes and the calm water band beneath them.
must_preserve: soft grey wash gradients forming atmospheric mist
thin wandering contour lines of distant hills
faint layered wave lines on the lake surface
blurred mist edges where mountains dissolve into water
minimal pale negative space between ridge layers

motifs.name: central_waterfall_cliff
motifs.description: Isolate the tall pale central cliff face with the vertical waterfall-like wash running down through surrounding rock ribs.
must_preserve: long vertical pale wash streaks suggesting falling water
curving cliff outlines on both sides of the cascade
dry-brush rock texture and scattered dotting along the ledges
darker ink knots where side ravines meet the fall
transparent wash texture over the broad cliff plane

motifs.name: right_terraced_rock_slope
motifs.description: Isolate the steep right-hand mountainside with layered ledges, stepped striations, and narrow shelf-like paths cut into the rock.
must_preserve: parallel horizontal ledge strokes
dark short hatch marks along the terrace edges
curved descending contour of the slope
broken rock outlines and small angular projections
pale wash over the broad sloping rock faces

motifs.name: dark_bamboo_grove_base
motifs.description: Isolate the dense dark grove at the base of the central cliff, with many vertical stalks and clustered foliage dots.
must_preserve: tight black foliage dot clusters
thin vertical bamboo or tree-stem strokes
irregular dark canopy edge following the mountain base
small rocks embedded among the trunks
contrast between dense ink grove and pale cliff wash behind it

motifs.name: midground_roof_village
motifs.description: Isolate the lakeside village cluster in the lower middle-right: rows of small houses, angular tiled roofs, low walls, and terraces nestled below leafless trees.
must_preserve: fine roof-line geometry with pitched eaves
rectangular wall outlines and courtyard divisions
thin ink strokes indicating terraces and paths
varied roof sizes receding into the hillside
delicate placement of houses among rocks and trees

motifs.name: foreground_leafless_trees
motifs.description: Isolate the large group of bare winter trees in the lower left foreground, including dark trunks, branching crowns, and adjacent brushy shrubs.
must_preserve: forking black trunk lines and exposed roots
fine twig networks with many small angular branch tips
contrasting thicker main trunks and hairline branches
vertical reed-like strokes at the far left
rocky ground strokes around the tree bases

motifs.name: foreground_water_bank
motifs.description: Isolate the bottom foreground water inlet with smooth dark wash, rocky banks, pale sandbars, and the narrow path edge above it.
must_preserve: horizontal water wash with darker pooled center
irregular rocky shoreline outlines
dry-brush texture on pale sandbars and foreground rocks
small broken stones along the far bank
subtle transition from bank path to water surface

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
